en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 3.  Amirul Momineen (a.s.) says, “Whenever people of the earth  commit  sins  or  get  involved  in  wrong  deeds,  the Almighty Allah intends to send down His chastisement on the  people  of the world.  However  when  He  sees  elderly people praying and young children learning Quran, He feels pity on them and does not send down His chastisement.”
